correctness.rationale: Locality radius below shortest side, adjacent-side angular reach and disjoint-side separation makes the chord-pair integration exact for all sufficiently small r. Same-side ordered parameter area sum equals 2Pr−nr²; adjacent sides make a cone of opening β with Jacobian sinβ and contribute βr²/sinβ per vertex; baseline boundary-arc CDF is 2r/P. Therefore exact excess r²/P² Σ(β/sinβ−1) with no higher terms. Power series for x/sin x has positive even coefficients and f>1/3, so Jensen yields universal 1/6 angle variance and only equiangular equality; alternating β on tangential n-gons for n→∞ gives optimality. Square direct check gives quadratic coefficient π/8−1/4.

originality.rationale: Published polygon short-distance angular stability result, examined in full, concerns AREA-uniform interior pairs with a quartic coefficient and does not imply the boundary arclength versus intrinsic-arc quadratic law. Mean boundary distances, random chords and area-uniform polygon algorithms are different measures/invariants. Older perimeter-point short-distance computations may overlap; best-of-knowledge qualification.

No global-in-r distribution or radius uniform over polygons; 1/6 sharp across n not necessarily fixed n.
